title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy dish originating from Saudi Arabia, made with tender lamb and served as kebabs.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.notes: Use lean lamb for best results

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian spices (xtra)
ingredients.notes: A mix of spices commonly used in Saudi Arabian cuisine

ingredients.name: Dense olive oil
ingredients.notes: For marinating and cooking the lamb

ingredients.name: Arabian dates
ingredients.notes: Optional, for serving as a side dish

instructions: 2. Cut the lamb into 1-inch pieces and place in a large bowl.
3. In a small bowl, mix together the xtra, salt, and pepper.
4. Add the spice mixture to the lamb and toss to coat.
5. Heat the dense olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.
6. Add the Arabian dates to the saucepan and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until caramelized.
7. Thread the lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
8. Brush the kebabs with the remaining saucepan oil and season with salt and pepper.
9. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
10. Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional Arabian dates if desired.
